data.segment_title: Campaign 2008 / Obama vs. McCain / The Campaign / Missouri
data.segment_description:
(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  The battleground states in the Midwest in the presidential election campaign between Senators Barack Obama and John McCain noted; map shown; the standings of Obama and McCain in the latest CBS News/"New York Times"  poll cited.  

(Orlando: Dean Reynolds)  The Obama campaign in Florida featured; scenes shown from the campaign trail.  [Tampa Bay Rays baseball player David PRICE&nbsp- introduces Obama.]  [In Ft. Lauderdale in the rain, Senator Hillary CLINTON&nbsp- campaigns.]  [In Tampa, OBAMA&nbsp- campaigns against McCain and Governor Sarah Palin's negative campaigning.]  Former Secretary of State Colin Powell's endorsement of Obama noted.  The poll findings of the voters' view of Obama over McCain after the three presidential debates cited.  

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.  

(Belton, Missouri: Chip Reid)  The McCain campaign featured; scenes shown from Missouri.  [McCAIN&nbsp- campaigns on taxes and against Obama; states we don't want a president who invites testing.]  Poll findings on the public view of the presidential candidates and taxes cited.  [On "The Early Show," McCAIN&nbsp- says the undecided voter will break.]  

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Further coverage of the interview with McCain mentioned.  Poll findings on the close race in Missouri cited.  

(Fenton, Missouri: Katie Couric)  The presidential race in the bellwether state of Missouri examined; scenes shown of a demonstration by the two "Rednecks for Obama"; details given about Obama's campaign spending and about the declining economy in the state.  [In a bar, McCain supporter Larry FLEMMING†; Rednecks for Obama Les SPENCER†; in interview, Chrysler workers Brenda CARTER†, Bruce REECE†- offer views on the election.]  

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  The close race in Ohio according to the Mason-Dixon poll cited.  

(Painesville, Ohio: Jeff Greenfield)  The importance of the battleground state of Ohio for McCain where Obama's ground game has neutralized a Republican advantage examined; details given about the Republican strategy.  ["Cleveland Plain Dealer" reporter Mark NAYMIK†- says Obama is making a run in '08.]  Map shown of the key counties.  [Lake County Republican Party chair Dale FELLOWS†- outlines the race in Ohio; states we are trying to show who Obama really is.]  McCain campaign robocall about Obama and Bill Ayers played.  [Cuyahoga County commissioner Tim HAGAN†- assesses the subtlety {race} of the Republican case.]

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  The lead for Senator John McCain over Senator Barack Obama in Indiana according to the CNN/"Time" poll cited.  [Brian HOWEY&nbsp- says the Republicans have had their way in the state but McCain-Palin have been outperformed in the state by Obama; states the Obama plan is to offset racism in the state with new voters: a barnburner in Indiana.]

data.segment_title: Iraq War / Emotional Wounds / Wounded Dinner
data.segment_description: (St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.   (Washington: David Martin)  A weekly dinner for soldiers wounded in the war in Iraq to help them heal emotionally featured; scenes shown of the gatherings that were started five years ago.  [Injured vet John BORDERS, Wounded Dinner co-founder Hal KOSTER†, vet Christopher BAIN†, wounded soldier Sgt. Rafael DELGADO†- comment on the what the gathering means for them.]
